_why.~: Home is denied by default, so unlisted secrets stay unreadable from bash.
_why.~/dev: George's code, including this config repo (samwise-reflect runs from it).
_why.~/.pi/samwise/memory: Read-only memory for samwise-reflect context; wisdom changes only via George's apply.
_why.~/.nvm: nvm binaries and libraries; a global npmrc under versions/node/*/etc/npmrc would be readable; keep npm tokens in ~/.npmrc.
_why.~/.npm-global/bin: Global npm binaries; not its etc/npmrc.
_why.~/.npm-global/lib: Global npm packages including Pi's docs; not its etc/npmrc.
_why.~/.volta: Volta binaries and libraries; a global npmrc under tools/image/node/*/etc/npmrc would be readable; keep npm tokens in ~/.npmrc.
_why.~/.asdf: asdf toolchains; a global npmrc under installs/nodejs/*/etc/npmrc would be readable; keep npm tokens in ~/.npmrc.
_why.~/.cargo/git: Git crate sources; not its credentials.
_why.~/.gitconfig: Git commit identity; credentials files stay denied.
_why.~/.config/git/config: Git commit identity; credentials files stay denied.
_why./usr: System files already readable by bash; allow read tool access without prompts.
_why./opt: System files already readable by bash; allow read tool access without prompts.
_why./etc: System files already readable by bash; allow read tool access without prompts.
_why./private/etc: System files already readable by bash; allow read tool access without prompts.
_why./Library: System files already readable by bash; allow read tool access without prompts.
_why./Applications: System files already readable by bash; allow read tool access without prompts.
_why./System: System files already readable by bash; allow read tool access without prompts.
_why./bin: System files already readable by bash; allow read tool access without prompts.
_why./sbin: System files already readable by bash; allow read tool access without prompts.
The project Samwise is working in.
_why..pi: Project Pi config: sandbox.json can disable the fence; extensions/ is code Pi loads.
_why..git/hooks: Git hooks run code outside the fence.
_why..git/config: Git config can run code outside the fence.
_why.**/.git/hooks/*: Hooks are flat files; * (not /**, which the runtime strips) covers them for bash and Pi's tools.
_why.**/.git/config: Config of nested repositories at any depth can run code outside the fence.
_why..git/modules/**/hooks/*: Hooks are flat files; * (not /**, which the runtime strips) covers them for bash and Pi's tools.
_why..git/modules/**/config: Submodule config can run code outside the fence.
_why..git/commondir: A commondir file redirects git's config and hooks to another directory.
_why.**/.git/commondir: A commondir file redirects git's config and hooks to another directory.
_why..git/modules/**/commondir: A commondir file redirects git's config and hooks to another directory.
_why.**/.git: A nested .git gitlink file can point git at a directory with its own config and hooks; this matches only that path, leaving this project's .git contents writable.
_why..git/worktrees: Linked worktrees' admin dirs hold commondir and gitdir files.
_why.~/.pi/agent: George's own Pi settings, auth and extensions; only ~/.pi/samwise/agent has a policy link.
_why.~/.pi/samwise/agent: Samwise agent directory: settings, auth, extensions, and policy link.
_why.~/.pi/samwise/tools: qmd binaries are run by the unfenced host process; bash must not replace them.
_why.~/.pi/samwise/qmd: qmd config and index are read by the unfenced host process; bash must not alter them.
_why.~/.cache/qmd: qmd models are loaded by the unfenced host process.
_why..env: Secrets; explicit denyWrite replaces pi-sandbox defaults.
_why..env.*: Secrets; explicit denyWrite replaces pi-sandbox defaults.
_why.*.pem: Private keys; explicit denyWrite replaces pi-sandbox defaults.
_why.*.key: Private keys; explicit denyWrite replaces pi-sandbox defaults.
_why.github.com: GitHub web and git over HTTPS.
